title: Holographic optical field recovery using a regularized untrained deep decoder network
summary: The untrained deep decoder with physical forward model reconstructs amplitude and phase from a single hologram, demonstrated on cheek-cell and blood-smear images against multi-height holography/bright-field references, with stated phase and ill-posedness limits.
ai_technology: Regularized untrained deep decoder with a physical hologram forward model

evidence.tested: The untrained deep decoder with physical forward model reconstructs amplitude and phase from a single hologram, demonstrated on cheek-cell and blood-smear images against multi-height holography/bright-field references, with stated phase and ill-posedness limits.
